card.name: "To" after instruct patients: report symptoms
card.fires_on: The word "to" (or "for") right after counseling verbs such as instruct, tell, advise or monitor, just before an instruction to report, alert or watch for symptoms. Seen in patient-counseling sections of drug labels.

modes.label: To after counsel verb
modes.description: "to" following "Tell/Instruct/Advise patients" and leading into a request to report or inform.
modes.example: Tell patients<< to>> report development of blisters or erosions

modes.label: Monitor for
modes.description: "for" after "monitor" where the next words name changes to watch for.
modes.example: Counsel family members or caregivers of patients to monitor<< for>> changes in behavior and to alert the healthcare

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words about observing, noticing and unusual or unexpected signs.
card.plain: It fires on the small word that introduces what patients should watch for and report to their provider.
